criteria.name: Client interview and fact-gathering
criteria.description: Plans and conducts an effective intake interview of a distressed client that develops a complete factual record.

subcriteria.name: Rapport and interview technique
subcriteria.description: Opens with an open-ended invitation, attends to wellbeing, avoids interruption, and builds trust without pressure or flattery.

subcriteria.name: Surfacing guarded and concealed facts
subcriteria.description: Notices and gently follows hints to develop the rapport-gated and concealed facts (the wall incident, the children left home, the undisclosed relationship, suspected cash income).

subcriteria.name: Chronology and completeness
subcriteria.description: Produces an accurate chronology and a complete, well-organized factual record from the interview and case file.

criteria.name: Counseling the distressed client
criteria.description: Counsels a vulnerable client on realistic options while managing emotion and expectations.

subcriteria.name: Realistic option-framing
subcriteria.description: Explains custody, home, business-valuation, and maintenance options honestly, including the client's maintenance exposure, without false comfort or fatalism.

subcriteria.name: Empathy and expectation management
subcriteria.description: Responds to the client's guilt and fear with empathy, distinguishes labels from outcomes, and keeps the children's interests central.

criteria.name: Settlement strategy and negotiation
criteria.description: Builds and prepares to execute a strategic settlement-and-negotiation plan.

subcriteria.name: Prioritization and tradeoffs
subcriteria.description: Prioritizes a durable parenting schedule and treats property questions as tradeable; identifies interests behind positions.

subcriteria.name: Business valuation and maintenance analysis
subcriteria.description: Analyzes how to value the one-person business and how the income disparity drives the maintenance question, and plans the needed discovery/experts.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Identifies and honors the governing ethical duties.

subcriteria.name: Rule 4.2 no-contact with represented party
subcriteria.description: Recognizes that Harlan is represented and routes any contact through his counsel rather than communicating with him directly.

subcriteria.name: Confidentiality of sensitive disclosures
subcriteria.description: Protects the client's most sensitive disclosures and reasons carefully about what appears in served documents.

criteria.name: Drafting the initiating documents
criteria.description: Translates the case theory into a competent petition, proposed parenting plan, and property proposal.
